Screen-Space Fluid Rendering in VTK - Kitware
Introduction Particle-based fluid simulations are very popular in computer graphics. For coolant flow, engine analysis, blood flow, and interactive applications, particle-based simulation methods are often preferred over grid-based ones, as they compute fast and offer a number of advantages such as well-defined fluid volume and the flexibility to model interaction with rigid surfaces.
